messages:
zoe: opened PR 9002 to add trace propagation examples (Python + Go) to Console instrumentation and a short migration note for a YAML key rename. fixed one dead dashboard anchor, need reviewers.

liam: which pages changed? I can check anchors and links.

zoe: docs/dashboards and docs/console/instrumentation. change: traceKey -> trace_key in YAML samples; samples will show both for compatibility.

ara: paste snippets so I can run them in the examples runner.

zoe: Python first:
```py
# Python (redwood==0.10)
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.attach_trace(trace_id='t-001', attrs={'route':'/v1/generate','model':'r-1'}, cost={'tokens':5})
# then client.generate(..., trace_context=client.current_trace())
```

zoe: Go:
```go
// Go (inference-go v0.4+)
ctx := context.Background()
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
ctx = redwood.WithTrace(ctx, redwood.Trace{ID: "t-001", Attrs: map[string]string{"route":"/v1/generate"}, Cost: redwood.Cost{Tokens: 5}})
// pass ctx to client.Generate(ctx, ...)
```

mike: nit: mention the SDK version differences (WithTrace added v0.4; Python package name changed in 0.10). Also the Go Cost.Tokens type is int64 in the SDK.

zoe: good call. I'll add a version note above each snippet.

docs-bot: link-checker: replaced /docs/dashboards#old-row-anchor -> /docs/dashboards#row-mapping. confirm anchor exists.

ara: ran examples: Python worked after adjusting import; Go needed Tokens typed as integer. I updated the snippet locally. also uploaded dashboard screenshot and added alt text.

liam: can we add a tiny CI smoke test that YAML-parses the example so camelCase vs snake_case regressions are caught?

mike: I'll add a docs-ci lint step that runs `python -c "import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open('docs/examples/trace_sample.yaml'))"`. non-blocking on flakes.

zoe: thanks — I'll push the fixes (version notes, compatibility YAML showing both keys, alt text, snippet tweaks) and mark PR with `docs: trace-samples`. aiming to merge after CI green.

liam: approved pending CI.

mike: CI passed, merging. thanks everyone!
